## What shipped

`GET /` — an async Server Component dashboard that queries the send log (last 200 records), maps DB rows to a serialisable view-model via `toSendLogRow`, and passes them to `<LogTable>`. The Client Component owns filter state (category + status dropdowns) and row-expand state, applying `filterSendLogRows` on every render — no useEffect, no client-side fetch. Failed rows have a chevron expand button (`aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, Escape-to-collapse) that reveals `error_detail` in an inline detail row. DB connection failure shows a `role="alert"` banner with no raw error text exposed. Empty state links to `/test-send`. All filter selects have `sr-only` labels; `<tbody>` carries `aria-live="polite"` for screen-reader announcements on filter change.

## What didn't ship

Nothing deferred. The two reviewer warns (F1, F2) were resolved by the coordinator before promotion.

## Gate triggers

- **Reviewer F1 (warn → fixed):** `aria-live="polite"` missing from filter result region. Coordinator added `aria-live="polite" aria-relevant="additions removals"` to `<tbody>` in `src/app/(dashboard)/LogTable.tsx`. Suite re-run: 355/355. No retry needed.
- **Reviewer F2 (warn → fixed):** Escape-to-collapse not implemented. Architect brief §6 said "Do not add custom keydown handlers" but this contradicted the global accessibility commitment. Coordinator applied `onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape' && isExpanded) toggle(row.id) }}` to the expand button. Suite re-run: 355/355. No retry needed.

## Decisions / open questions / risks filed during this run

- **D011 — Client-side filtering over URL-param server re-fetch (filed in `docs/build/decisions/D011-send-log-dashboard-client-filtering.md`):** Design A chosen — single server fetch, pure filter function, testable under `environment: 'node'`, no async failure path on filter change. URL-param approach rejected: splits filter logic, introduces server re-fetch latency, breaks node-only Vitest testability.

## Notes / observations

- **`<React.Fragment key={row.id}>` is required for two-`<tr>` table rows.** When `map()` returns two consecutive `<tr>` elements (data row + detail row), the `key` must sit on the outermost element. `<React.Fragment key={...}>` is the only correct form — shorthand `<>` does not accept a `key` prop.
- **`vi.mock` + dynamic import pattern for Server Components with transitive DB imports.** `src/app/page.tsx` transitively pulls `@/send-log` → `@/db` → `neon(process.env.DATABASE_URL!)`. Static import at test module level fails in `environment: 'node'`. Solution: `vi.mock(...)` calls at top of test file, then `const { default: Home } = await import('./page')` inside the test body. Pattern now used in both `src/app/page.test.tsx` and `src/db/index.test.ts`.
- **Inline accessibility fixes by coordinator are acceptable when the reviewer warns are < 5 lines and the fix is prescriptively documented.** Both F1 and F2 had suggested fixes in the reviewer output; coordinator applied them verbatim and re-ran the gate. No retry agent spawn was needed.
- **Architect brief §6 ("no custom keydown handlers") contradicted the global accessibility gate.** This was a coordinator error in the pre-spawn review — the brief should have been corrected before the coder spawned. Pattern to remember: always cross-check WU brief constraints against `docs/build/design-system/accessibility.md` before the coder runs.
- **Test count trajectory:** 110 → 136 → 189 → 220 → 258 → 286 → 323 → 355 (WU-011, +32 tests).
